exact: positive regulation of cell migration by VEGF-activated platelet derived growth factor receptor signalling pathway
positive regulation of cell migration by VEGF/PDGFR signaling pathway

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) binding to a platelet-derived growth factor receptor (PDGFR) on the surface of a cell, which activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the orderly movement of a cell from one site to another.
label: positive regulation of cell migration by VEGF-activated platelet derived growth factor receptor signaling pathway
